image_description: A close-up portrait of a rooster (cock) head and neck. The bird features a prominent, bright red serrated comb and wattles. The plumage is primarily black with iridescent sheens, particularly on the neck hackles. The beak is yellow-orange with a dark tip. The eye is golden-yellow with a round pupil. A small signature 'Eric' is visible in the bottom right corner.
